text:
Release Bot: post-deploy synth smoke for rollout v2026.05.02 completed with partial failures in websocket handshake checks. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3951234567 :warning:
Anika: seeing sporadic 502 on /ws/handshake in eu-central at 16:22UTC, about ~7 failures across 3 hosts. small blast radius.
QA Lead: synth summary: ws-handshake-check -> 502 bad-gateway host=10.33.9.11..14, cookie=rds=v2026.05.02. retry queued.
Marco: i'm on-call for eu-central. checking envoy logs 7>16:22:137 shows upstream connect reset to backend pods that were just rotated. suspect LB cookie mapping to old pod ids.
infra-bot: traced failure: cookie digest mismatch after pod IP change during rolling update.
Anika: would prefer not to rollback the whole rollout. proposal: pin /ws/handshake in eu-central to previous variant v2026.04.30 and flip the handshake_cookie_mode to lax on v2026.05.02, then rerun smoke.
deploy-bot: executing: redwood route pin --route /ws/handshake --to v2026.04.30 --region eu-central
deploy-bot: pin complete. traffic routing updated to v2026.04.30 in eu-central. :white_check_mark:
ops: applied feature flag handshake_cookie_mode=lax on v2026.05.02 variant. kicked off synth rerun.
QA Lead: synth rerun (id ss-3951234567-2) reports 200/200 checks OK, p95 34ms, no 5xx.
Marco: leaving pin for 15m to collect traces and client error budgets. will also add a short-term graceful-terminate delay to reduce pod churn during rolling updates.
infra-bot: opening follow-up ticket INF-10033 "LB cookie mapping and handshake resilience" and attaching traces + envoy logs.
Release Bot: rollout placed on hold. Pin set for 15m. Notifying #deploy-notify.
Anika: plan: after 15m and if metrics remain green, reintroduce v2026.05.02 for handshake with a 5% canary and monitor for 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
